purpose: Measure repeatable per-level production effort without authorizing bulk level production.
applies_when: P2-001 or later controlled level authoring is authorized by its dependency gates

measurement_rules.wall_clock_seconds: finished_at minus started_at; ISO-8601 timestamps required
measurement_rules.human_seconds: design + level_data + visual_assembly + qa + human_review_rework stage seconds
measurement_rules.rework_cycles: non-negative integer; increment only after a completed review requests another production pass
measurement_rules.content_fingerprint: immutable SHA-256 of canonical Level Data/content input used for this measurement

batch_acceptance.note: Thresholds for acceptable cost are a later evidence-based production decision; this contract prevents inventing them before representative levels exist.

guardrails: Do not create levels solely to populate this metric while P2-001 is dependency-blocked.
Do not treat solver runtime as human authoring time.
Do not exclude failed/reworked attempts from batch evidence.
Do not use this metric as proof of gameplay fun or human quality.
Do not scale to 30/144 levels from synthetic fixtures.
